text: The Patriots' Week 7 Thursday Night Football matchup against the Bears in Chicago resulted in a 30-24 loss, with Caleb Williams and the Bears prevailing in what proved to be a thriller despite New England's efforts to keep pace. Rhamondre Stevenson continued his impressive season by reaching a career high in receiving yards, underscoring his value as a multifaceted running back who handles the little things well and is on pace for his sixth straight season of 100 carries, though the Patriots entered the game already depleted along the offensive line with starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown ruled out. Film review of Drake Maye's performance and the Patriots' defensive scheme from Thursday night has generated considerable analysis among beat writers examining what went wrong in the loss, with postgame quotes from head coach Mike Vrabel and select players providing insight into the team's perspective on the contest.
